> **Completeness notice:** the automated testing is complete and its results are below. **Manual testing is NOT complete: 0 of 65 manual cases have been executed.** This report therefore does not claim that Assessment 8 is fully complete. See section 6 and `manual_testing/manual_test_report.md`.

## 1. Scope and module under test

Module: **Room Allocation** - allocating a student to a room, reallocating, cancelling, listing/searching allocations, listing available rooms, the student's own view, role-based access (admin, warden, student, accountant) and the authentication/CSRF/session behaviour these depend on. It is tested through the real Flask application (routes, templates, database), not through mocks.

## 2. Test scenarios

16 module requirements (RA-01..) are defined in `docs/requirements.csv` and mapped to tests in `requirements_traceability.md`:

- **RA-01** Admin and warden can allocate an available room to a student.
- **RA-02** Allocation input is validated (required fields, existing student and room, ISO dates within 2000-2100, end date not before start) with clear messages.
- **RA-03** A student has at most one active allocation; cancelled history does not block a new allocation.
- **RA-04** Room capacity is never exceeded; full and maintenance rooms refuse allocation; room status follows occupancy.
- **RA-05** An active allocation can be moved to another room with a free bed; counters move consistently; invalid moves change nothing.
- **RA-06** An active allocation can be cancelled after confirmation; the bed is freed; a cancelled allocation cannot be cancelled or reallocated again.
- **RA-07** Admin and warden can list, search, filter (block, status) and paginate allocations.
- **RA-08** Available rooms are listed for admin, warden and student, filterable by block, with an option to include full rooms.
- **RA-09** A student can view only their own allocation.
- **RA-10** Role-based access: only admin and warden manage allocations, rooms and students; students and accountants are refused.
- **RA-11** Authentication: valid logins by role, invalid logins rejected, POST-only logout, safe redirects, lockout after repeated failures, stale sessions handled.
- **RA-12** CSRF protection on every state-changing request (login, create, reallocate, cancel, logout).
- **RA-13** Secure configuration: no hard-coded secret, debug off by default, demo data and credentials opt-in, security headers, hardened cookies, self-hosted assets.
- **RA-14** SQL-injection and XSS input is handled safely (no SQL error, output escaped, data intact).
- **RA-15** Role-specific dashboards show accurate statistics and shortcuts.
- **RA-16** Admin can add hostel blocks, rooms and students through the interface (validated, CSRF-protected, admin only) so a fresh installation can be populated and used.

## 7. Defects

54 defects are registered (`defect_log.md`): **42 fixed and verified, 9 open, 2 accepted, 1 rejected.**

| Severity | Fixed | Accepted | Open | Rejected | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| High | 6 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 7 |
| Medium | 24 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 26 |
| Low | 12 | 2 | 7 | 0 | 21 |
| **Total** | **42** | **2** | **9** | **1** | **54** |

Open / accepted items:

- **DEF-002** (Low, Accepted) Room numbers are unique per block, not globally - Rooms are always shown with their block name.
- **DEF-004** (Low, Open) Past start dates are accepted by the server (back-dating) - Decide whether back-dating is a requirement; align the form and the server.
- **DEF-007** (Low, Open) Warden approval workflow not implemented - Feature outside the implemented scope.
- **DEF-039** (High, Open) Manual tests were reported as executed but never were - BLOCKING for the "execute manual tests" requirement of Assessment 8.
- **DEF-045** (Medium, Open) Reallocation overwrites the allocation row; no movement history - Add an allocation-history table if auditability is required.
- **DEF-046** (Low, Open) Login throttle is per-process memory (not shared between workers; resets on restart) - Use a shared store (e.g. Redis) before running several workers.
- **DEF-047** (Low, Open) New DB constraints only apply to newly created databases (no migration tooling) - Recreate or migrate any pre-existing hms.db.
- **DEF-048** (Low, Open) MySQL has no partial indexes: one-active-allocation rule is application-level only there - SQLite (default) and PostgreSQL are covered.
- **DEF-049** (Low, Open) CSP allows inline styles (templates use style attributes) - Move inline styles to CSS classes, then drop style-src unsafe-inline.
- **DEF-050** (Low, Accepted) Secure cookie flag and HSTS are opt-in (need HTTPS)
- **DEF-053** (Low, Open) Blocks, rooms and students can be added but not edited or deleted through the interface - Corrections currently need database access. Out of scope for the Room Allocation module.

## 8. Overall assessment of the module

- **Functional correctness:** all 317 automated tests pass, covering allocation, reallocation, cancellation, capacity limits, validation, role-based access and dashboards.
- **Data integrity:** bed counters are changed with atomic conditional updates and guarded by database CHECK constraints and a partial unique index; a stale-object test reproduces the former lost-update defect and now passes.
- **Security:** CSRF is enforced on every state-changing request (tested with protection enabled); logout is POST-only; login is throttled; stale sessions are handled; secure defaults and headers are tested.
- **Coverage:** 91.6% combined statement+branch coverage of `hms_app` (see `results/test_metrics.md` for uncovered files/lines).
- **Limits of this evidence:** manual tests are not executed (section 6); concurrency was tested with a deterministic stale-object scenario, not with parallel load; the app was tested with SQLite only; the login throttle is per-process; browser checks ran in one engine (headless Chrome).

pip install -r requirements-test.txt
